;Arts and culture
*[[2020 in archaeology]]
**The [[Ministry of Antiquities (Egypt)|Tourism and Antiquities Ministry]] of [[Egypt]] states that they have discovered ancient coffins at the [[necropolis]] in [[Saqqara]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/egypt-says-another-trove-of-ancient-coffins-found-in-saqqara/2020/10/19/2c2bcb94-1212-11eb-a258-614acf2b906d_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Epsilon|Tropical Storm Epsilon]] forms in the Atlantic Ocean and is expected to bring [[tropical storm|storm]]-force winds to [[Bermuda]] later this week.  [https://www.royalgazette.com/news/weather/article/20201019/storm-force-winds-may-be-on-the-way/ (''The Royal Gazette'')]
*A magnitude 7.5 [[earthquake]] strikes the [[Alaska Peninsula]], prompting [[tsunami]] warnings. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/10/19/7point5-magnitude-quake-off-alaska-prompts-tsunami-warning-.html (CNBC)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Russia]]
*****It is announced that the first results of [[Russia]]'s clinical trial for its [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine will include data from 5,000 to 10,000 people. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-vaccine-dat-idUSKBN27422I (Reuters)]
****[[Russia]]'s new cases surge to a new record high of 15,982 in the last 24 hours, including 5,376 in [[Moscow]], pushing the case total to 1,415,316. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-cases-idUSKBN2740TI (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wales]], [[COVID-19 lockdowns|COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
*****[[First Minister of Wales|First Minister]] [[Mark Drakeford]] announces that [[Wales]] will introduce a "firebreak" lockdown, which will require anyone to stay home between October 23 and November 9. Under those rules, pubs, restaurants, hotels, and non-essential businesses must close; primary schools will reopen after the half-term break, but only seventh and eighth years in secondary schools can return at that time under the new "firebreak" rules. In addition, gathering with people from other households indoors or outdoors will be banned. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-54598136 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Chancellor of Austria|Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] announces that private gatherings of more than six people indoors and twelve people outdoors will be banned in [[Austria]] from October 23, in an effort to curb the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.dpa-international.com/topic/austria-limits-indoor-gatherings-six-people-slow-covid-19-urn%3Anewsml%3Adpa.com%3A20090101%3A201019-99-02593 (Dpa international)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], [[COVID-19 lockdowns|COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Taoiseach]] [[Micheál Martin]] announces that [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] will move to Level Five for a period of six weeks. The new restrictions will take effect at midnight on October 21 and remain in place until December 1. Under Level Five restrictions, non-essential business will close, people will only be able to exercise within {{convert|5|km|mi}} of their homes except for essential reasons, and no social or family gatherings are allowed in homes or gardens. However, schools and creches are to remain open, and elite sporting events can take place. [https://www.gov.ie/en/press-release/66269-ireland-placed-on-level-5-of-the-plan-for-living-with-covid/ (Gov.ie)] [https://www.itv.com/news/utv/2020-10-19/republic-of-ireland-to-move-to-highest-level-of-covid-restrictions (ITV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****The [[Government of Slovenia|government]] formally declares 30-day nationwide "state of epidemic" (known overseas as [[state of emergency]]) starting today. There are no changes for employees, students and others, but 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time curfew will be imposed tomorrow. The decree also limits gatherings to six people and movement among regions unless for essential or emergency reasons will be banned. [https://www.gov.si/en/news/2020-10-18-prime-minister-janez-jansa-the-epidemic-has-been-declared-today-for-the-whole-of-slovenia/ (Government of Slovenia)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/slovenia-brings-in-curfew-to-fight-virus-surge-01603113004?tesla=y (''Barrons'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The [[Government of Navarre|President of Navarra]], [[María Chivite]], announces a perimetral lockdown of the [[Navarra|region]], closing bars and restaurants, and limiting gatherings to [[cohabiting]] people, starting on Thursday and lasting for 15 days. In the last two weeks, Navarra has experienced a cumulative incidence of more than 900 per 100,000 inhabitants. [https://www.eldiario.es/navarra/navarra-confina-limita-entradas-salidas-comunidad-cierra-bares-restaurantes-frenar-contagios_1_6304183.html (''eldiario.es'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
*****The [[Israel Institute for Biological Research]] announces that its [[COVID-19 vaccine]] candidate will be named as Brilife, with [[Phases of clinical research#Phase I|phase 1]] [[Vaccine trial|human trails]] expected to start during the end of the month. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/israel-names-its-vaccine-candidate-brilife-646254 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports 337 new deaths in the previous 24 hours, a new record of deaths since the beginning of the pandemic, pushing the death toll in the country to 30,712. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/iran-daily-covid-19-death-toll-hits-a-record-337-state-tv-13314464 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fifth country to do so after the [[United States]], [[India]], [[Brazil]], and [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54609384 (BBC News)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[Canada]] surpasses 200,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/covid-19-cases-in-canada-surpass-200-000-1.5151488 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Sinovac Biotech]]'s [[CoronaVac]] appears to be safe in providing protection against COVID-19, as preliminary results of [[Phase III clinical trials|Phase III]] clinical trial in [[Brazil]] show. [[São Paulo]]'s [[Instituto Butantan]], one of Brazil's leading biomedical research centres carrying out the trials, says CoronaVac proved to be safe after its two doses were applied to 9,000 volunteers, but said data on how effective it is in protecting people against COVID-19 will not be released until it has been tested on all 15,000 volunteers in newly expanded trials. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3106177/tests-show-coronavirus-vaccine-chinas-sinovac-safe-says-brazils (''South China Morning Post'')]
**The total number of worldwide confirmed [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases surpasses 40 million. The United States remains the global leader in case numbers, accounting for 20% of all cumulative cases, with India closely following at 19%. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2020/oct/19/coronavirus-live-news-global-infections-near-40m-as-us-covid-cases-rise-in-all-but-two-states?page=with:block-5f8d877b8f08d277d177d878 (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Sudan–United States relations]] 
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the U.S. will remove [[Sudan]] from the list of [[State Sponsors of Terrorism (U.S. list)|State Sponsors of Terrorism]] after Sudan deposits [[US$]]335 million in a fund to compensate families of American victims of the [[1998 United States embassy bombings]]. [[Sudanese Prime Minister]] [[Abdalla Hamdok]] thanks the [[U.S. government]] for the decision. The [[United States Congress]] would still have to approve restoring Sudan's [[sovereign immunity]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-usa/trump-u-s-to-remove-sudan-from-state-terrorism-sponsors-list-after-payment-to-victims-idUSKBN2742BE (Reuters)]
*[[Japan–Vietnam relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Yoshihide Suga]] says that the [[Japan|country]] has agreed with [[Vietnam]] to boost its defense ties and resume flights amid [[China|Chinese]] influence in the regions. [https://apnews.com/article/global-trade-yoshihide-suga-south-china-sea-hanoi-asia-0eaf782e0b27aab73cad46d6cb353e37 (AP)]

;Law and crime
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders#High Court of Justice of Catalonia|Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]]
**The [[High Court of Justice of Catalonia]] sentences former members of the Bureau of [[Parliament of Catalonia|Catalan Parliament]] [[Ramona Barrufet]], [[Lluís Corominas]], Lluís Guinó, and [[Anna Simó]] to 20 months of disqualification and a €30,000 fine for disobeying the court when this body warned them of the illegality involved in the processing of the [[Law of juridical transition and foundation of the Republic|disconnection]] and [[Law on the Referendum on Self-determination of Catalonia|self-determination referendum laws]] in 2017 and acting against the prohibition of the [[Constitutional Court of Spain]]. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20201019/484165444977/tsjc-sentencia-mesa-del-parlament-inhabilitacion-cataluna.html (''La Vanguardia'')] [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20201019/tsjc-condena-exmiembros-mesa-parlament-leyes-proces-catalunya-8162886 (''El Periódico'')]
*The [[United States Department of Justice]] announces charges against six current and former [[Russia]]n military officers for allegedly attempting to engage in [[malware]] and [[Security hacker|hacking]] in the [[2018 Winter Olympics]] and elections in other countries. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/doj-announces-charges-russian-gru-officers-allegedly-involved/story (ABC News)]
*A court denies an appeal from British [[socialite]] [[Ghislaine Maxwell]] regarding the release of her 2016 [[Deposition (law)|deposition]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/amp/news/articles/2020-10-19/maxwell-can-t-prevent-release-of-her-deposition-court-rules (Bloomberg.com)]
